privacyAssessment.sensitivity: Internal spending configuration. The only person-linked fact is the id of the user who last set the allowance (an existing User FK, the same pattern as configuredById and upstreamFeedbackOptInById); no content about a person.
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: The FK is ON DELETE SET NULL, so deleting the user clears the attribution without removing the setting. Visible only to people holding manage_platform and manage_finance.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: The facts follow the existing singleton row and its lifecycle; no new table, journal or retention copy.

migration.backfill: None. Existing rows read NULL, meaning no owner allowance is set, so the registry per-agent caps keep applying to paid usage until an owner records one.
migration.rollback: Forward-only additive columns. Older source never reads them and keeps the per-agent caps. Rolling back the code with an allowance set simply returns to the per-agent caps; the columns can stay.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing installation singleton; the allowance and its attribution follow the row.

fields.reason: Owner-set USD per UTC day for per-token-priced inference across the installation. NULL means not set (per-agent caps apply); 0 permits no paid calls.
